Chapter and Conventual Mass.subject: Sports
Chapter and Conventual Mass.question: The _____ was Types of christian worship.
Chapter and Conventual Mass.fact: As currently used, the terms Chapter Mass (for chapters of canons) and Conventual Mass (for most other houses of religious) refer to the Mass celebrated by and for a community of priests or for a community of priests and brothers or sisters. Such Masses are normally concelebrated by most or all of the priests in a house in the case of a house of an order or other religious community that includes priests.

Chapter and Conventual Mass.subject: Sports
Chapter and Conventual Mass.question: The Mass and _____ celebrated are those of the day, according to the rubrics and ordo of the order or house
Chapter and Conventual Mass.fact: It is normally linked with the Liturgy of the Hours, at which the community gathers to worship as a body: there are special norms in the rubrics for combining any one of the hours of the Divine Office with the celebration of Mass. The Mass and Office celebrated are those of the day, according to the rubrics and ordo of the order or house.

Chapter and Conventual Mass.subject: Sports

Chapter and Conventual Mass.subject: Sports

Chapter and Conventual Mass.subject: Sports

Chapter and Conventual Mass.subject: Sports
Chapter and Conventual Mass.question: It was not allowed to sing two high _____ both conformed to the office on the same day
Chapter and Conventual Mass.fact: It was not allowed to sing two high Masses both conformed to the office on the same day. On the other hand, there were cases in which two different conventual Masses were celebrated.

Chapter and Conventual Mass.subject: Sports

Chapter and Conventual Mass.subject: Sports
Chapter and Conventual Mass.question: When a Vigil, an Ember day or _____ fell within an octave (except that of the Blessed Sacrament) the office was of the octave and the Mass of the feria commemorating the octave
Chapter and Conventual Mass.fact: When a Vigil, an Ember day or Rogation Monday fell within an octave (except that of the Blessed Sacrament) the office was of the octave and the Mass of the feria commemorating the octave.

Chapter and Conventual Mass.subject: Sports
Chapter and Conventual Mass.question: Except in Advent, Lent and _____ time, on the first day of the month not prevented by a double or semi-double, the conventual Mass was a Requiem for deceased members and benefactors of the community
Chapter and Conventual Mass.fact: Except in Advent, Lent and Paschal time, on the first day of the month not prevented by a double or semi-double, the conventual Mass was a Requiem for deceased members and benefactors of the community.

Chapter and Conventual Mass.subject: Sports
Chapter and Conventual Mass.question: On doubles, semi-doubles _____ and during octaves, the conventual Mass was said after Terce, on simples and ferias after Sext, on ferias of Advent and Lent, on Vigils and Ember days after None
Chapter and Conventual Mass.fact: On doubles, semi-doubles Sundays and during octaves, the conventual Mass was said after Terce, on simples and ferias after Sext, on ferias of Advent and Lent, on Vigils and Ember days after None.

Chapter and Conventual Mass.subject: Sports
Chapter and Conventual Mass.question: There were also occasions on which several conventual _____ are said on the same day
Chapter and Conventual Mass.fact: Except in Advent and Lent, on Ember days, Rogation days and vigils, if the office was ferial and the Sunday Mass had already been said that week, the conventual Mass could have been one of the Votive Masses in the Missal appointed for each day in the week. There were also occasions on which several conventual Masses are said on the same day.

Chapter and Conventual Mass.subject: Sports
Chapter and Conventual Mass.question: On Ascension eve, if a double or semi-double occurs, the Mass of the feast was said after Terce, that of the Vigil after Sext, that of _____ after None
Chapter and Conventual Mass.fact: On ferias of Lent, on Ember days, Rogation days and Vigils when a double or semi-double occurs, or during an octave or when a Votive office was said, the Mass corresponding to the office is said after Terce, that of the feria after None. On Ascension eve, if a double or semi-double occurs, the Mass of the feast was said after Terce, that of the Vigil after Sext, that of Rogation after None.

Chapter and Conventual Mass.subject: Sports
Chapter and Conventual Mass.question: When an additional votive Mass had to be said (for instance for the _____ or for the anniversary of the bishop's consecration or enthronement, etc.) it was said after None
Chapter and Conventual Mass.fact: When an additional votive Mass had to be said (for instance for the Forty Hours or for the anniversary of the bishop's consecration or enthronement, etc.) it was said after None.

Chapter and Conventual Mass.subject: Sports
Chapter and Conventual Mass.question: On the _____ of each week (except in Lent and Paschal time) if the office was ferial the conventual Mass was permitted to be a Requiem
Chapter and Conventual Mass.fact: On the Monday of each week (except in Lent and Paschal time) if the office was ferial the conventual Mass was permitted to be a Requiem.

Chapter and Conventual Mass.subject: Sports
Chapter and Conventual Mass.question: But if it were a simple or a feria with a proper Mass, or if the _____ had not been said, the collect for the dead (Fidelium) was added to that of the day instead
Chapter and Conventual Mass.fact: But if it were a simple or a feria with a proper Mass, or if the Sunday Mass had not been said, the collect for the dead (Fidelium) was added to that of the day instead.

Chapter and Conventual Mass.subject: Sports
Chapter and Conventual Mass.question: These rules concerning the celebration of two or more conventual _____ applied as laws only to chapters
Chapter and Conventual Mass.fact: These rules concerning the celebration of two or more conventual Masses applied as laws only to chapters.
